name: Assemblage of Might
summary: At the start of your Command phase, pick an enemy unit; until your next Command phase, Adeptus Custodes Character units get +1 to wound against it.

name: Against All Odds
summary: An Adeptus Custodes non-Vehicle unit's attacks get +1 to hit and +1 to wound whenever no other friendly unit is within 6" of it.

name: March of the Honoured Dead
summary: Friendly Adeptus Custodes Walker units get +2" Move and +1 to Advance and Charge rolls. Exclusive Armoury-tagged detachment.

name: Creeping Dread (Aura)
summary: During your opponent's Battle-shock step, enemy Psyker units or units below their starting strength within 12" of an Anathema Psykana model must take a Battle-shock test; units below half-strength subtract 1 from it instead.

name: Martial Mastery
summary: At the start of the battle round, choose one effect until the next round for Adeptus Custodes models with Martial Ka'tah: melee Critical Hits trigger on an unmodified 5+, or their melee weapons get +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Skin-Crawling Disorientation
summary: An Anathema Psykana unit that advances can still start an action that turn. In your Shooting phase, it can mark a visible enemy unit within 12" as nulled, giving that unit +3" detection range.

name: Auric Armour
summary: Unshocked Custodes Vehicles (non-Aircraft) at full strength get +2 OC; below full strength, re-roll Hit rolls of 1; below half strength also re-roll Wound rolls of 1. Walkers get +2" Move, +1 Advance/Charge; up to 2 can become Characters.

name: Revered Companions
summary: Anathema Psykana units gain an aura: Adeptus Custodes units within 6" get Feel No Pain 5+ against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds. Every other Adeptus Custodes unit gains an aura: Anathema Psykana units within 6" get +1 to hit.

name: The Hammer Falls
summary: A friendly Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit that made an ingress move this turn can re-roll its charge roll. Exclusive Lions-tagged detachment.
